triage.note:
ENUMERATED DEBT, NOT A BUG BEING FIXED. This case is the D13 ruling's own gate coverage and it encodes a DIFFERENT defect from its sibling cvx-2015-internal-pointer.json. That case asserts min_chars on items 7 and 8 -- i.e. that the real MD&A and financial-statement text ends up INSIDE the span, which needs internal-pointer resolution. This case asserts nothing about span content at all. It asserts that three items whose entire body is an internal page pointer to content the output does not contain are not reported CLEAN. WHAT IS TRUE TODAY, derived by tasks/reviews/d13_span_dump.py --table: items 2, 6 and 7A report status=extracted at confidence 0.95 with review_required=false and no warning carrying their code, while meta.coverage is 0.2718 and 304,016 of 417,517 normalized chars lie outside every span. Item 6's body in full: 'Item 6. Selected Financial Data

The selected financial data for years 2011 through 2015 are presented on page FS-60.' (119 chars). Item 7A's: a pointer to 'page FS-15' and 'page FS-35'. Item 2's: a pointer to 'page 3 under Item 1. Business', to 'Tables I through VII on pages FS-61 through FS-71' and to 'Note 16 ... on page FS-41'. THE STATUS IS CORRECT AND IS PINNED AS CORRECT: the three item_present checks assert extracted, per ADR-004 shape 2, and they pass today. The debt is the three item_field checks, which are RED. WHY review_required AND NOT confidence: specs/001-sec10k-contract.md defines review_required as true exactly when some warning in `warnings` carries this item's code, and states that it is the same set of hits that moves confidence by WARN_PENALTY, 'so the two can never disagree'. Asserting the boolean therefore pins the same fact as a confidence bound while having exactly one failure mode, and it does not hard-code a penalty constant that ADR-018 may legitimately move. WHY THESE THREE AND NOT 7/8: items 7 and 8 in this same filing are the same shape and are NOT in this case, because ADR-035's item_span_near_empty already fires on them -- their confidence is 0.80 and review_required is true. The envelope already says what it must for 7 and 8; it says nothing for 2, 6 and 7A. That asymmetry is the whole content of the D13 ruling and is why these three, and only these three, are asserted. WHY IT IS NOT FIXED HERE: closing it means widening the item set ADR-035's SPAN_FLOOR reaches, which is the standing TD-5 debt row, and TD-5 records measured counter-evidence against a naive widening -- items 1A/7A/1B/4/6/9/9B/9C/16 are legitimately one sentence on real filings ('[Reserved]', 'None.'), so a bare floor on item 6 would fire on every 2021+ filing and re-open the vacuous_coverage finding ADR-027 section c closed. The trigger this needs is the pointer SHAPE, not the length alone. D13 is a decision row that rules on what is broken; it does not build, and no extractor behaviour changed in the commit that added this case (proved byte-identical against origin/main with evals/snapshot.py). RULED 2026-08-27 by ADR-038 (D13): specs/decisions/ADR-038-internal-pointer-adjudication.md rules these three items DEFECT at the escalation layer -- not at the segmentation layer, where the spans are verbatim-correct and ADR-004/ADR-005 stand unchanged. STANDING DISAGREEMENT: ADR-038 section d records where the extraction-auditor's independent blind re-read agreed with that ruling and where it did not; read that section before treating this case's red as settled. PROMOTED OUT OF DEBT 2026-08-28 by ADR-039 (D16), per this case's own runner note: specs/decisions/ADR-039-pointer-shape-escalation.md ships `internal_pointer_unreached`, the pointer-SHAPE validator ADR-038 section f row 1 named as the instrument that overturns its three `defect` verdicts, and this case moves from the unscored `debt` suite to fast+invariant as the fire-side band pin. The three original item_field checks now pass for the reason the D13 ruling demanded: a warning carries each item's code, so WARN_PENALTY takes 0.95 to 0.80 and review_required derives true -- score() and the derivation are untouched. Checks added at promotion: three warning_present (the mechanism, not just the outcome), three confidence value 0.8 (the WARN_PENALTY arithmetic, mirroring the sibling cvx-2015-pointer-flagged pins on items 7/8), and two warning_absent -- item 5 (body 1,814 chars, the measured no-fire edge of PTR_BODY_MAX's (515, 1814) band: a substantive Part II answer that cites pages and must never fire) and item 1 (82,890 chars, the substantive-body-that-mentions-a-page guard: it references the same FS tables item 2 points at and must never fire). STATUS STILL UNCHANGED AND STILL PINNED: the three item_present checks assert `extracted` as before -- ADR-004 shape 2 stands, per D16's Out-of-scope. The sibling cvx-2015-internal-pointer.json stays red debt: its min_chars checks encode internal-pointer RESOLUTION (TD-12, still declined), which ADR-039 deliberately does not build.
